title: Data Collection
content:
Observability systems typically leverage gateways or aggregators to handle the collection, batching, and piping of event data to a store like ClickHouse.
 
The OpenTelemetry Collector is a great option for this task - having established a data standard for communication between gateway and agent instances, the OpenTelemetry protocol is widely supported and well adopted across the industry.
 
It is worth noting that the OpenTelemetry ClickHouse exporter is in alpha, and although we have had no issues collecting petabytes of logs for our own internal observability platform, users should adhere to the advice provided by [OpenTelemetry](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector#alpha) accordingly.

title: ClickHouse
content:
**Ingestion**
ClickHouse is designed to handle large continuous streams of ingest data. In our own observability system, ClickHouse shines with ingestion rates upwards of gigabytes per second. See our documentation for how to get started with [async inserts](https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/cloud/bestpractices/asynchronous-inserts). **Data Processing**
ClickHouse is purpose-built to deliver the most efficient utilization of resources, which often results in significant cost savings. Developers report up to 10-100x in reduction of cost when switching to ClickHouse depending on alternatives considered. **Compression & Tiered Storage**
ClickHouse's [MergeTree suite of table engines](https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/engines/table-engines/mergetree-family/mergetree#table_engine-mergetree-multiple-volumes) are designed to support data across multiple block devices. This feature can be particularly useful for managing 'hot' and 'cold' data - where, for instance, a fraction of recent ('hot') data is accessed frequently, while a larger portion of historical ('cold') data is accessed infrequently. ClickHouse provides [flexible storage policies](https://clickhouse.com/docs/en/integrations/s3) that allow data to reside on local disks for a certain period before migrating them to object storage. This dynamic shift between local and remote storage ensures efficient use of resources, making it a practical solution for data storage and retrieval needs. The object storage cost could be optimized even further by leveraging features like S3 Intelligent-Tiering.

title: UI, Alerting & Reports
content: ClickHouse benefits from a vibrant ecosystem of integrations that includes visualization tools like Grafana and Superset. At ClickHouse, we leverage this [Grafana](https://grafana.com/grafana/plugins/grafana-clickhouse-datasource/) integration for our own internal observability system to power dashboards and alerting, as well as support for navigating logs and traces.
